About Teamified:

Teamified is a talent partner helping companies build exceptional remote teams across IT, software, product, and digital innovation. We collaborate with leading enterprises and fast-scaling tech businesses worldwide to help them access world class talent and accelerate growth. With operations across the globe our mission is to make building high performing global teams simple, fast, and cost-effective. Teamified has hundreds of clients with more than 200 engineers, testers, product managers, designers, and technology experts delivering impactful solutions every day.

About the client:

Our client is an innovative Australian health technology company developing an AI-powered anxiety coaching application based on an evidence-based psychological approach to managing anxiety.

The application is designed for iOS and Android using React Native, with a React-based website supporting user registration and subscriptions. Currently in the testing phase and approaching its soft launch, the platform features an AI-powered coaching assistant that uses Large Language Models (LLMs) to deliver structured, personalised coaching conversations.

The AI Coach operates within a clinically guided framework, incorporating structured coaching pathways, a toolkit of resources, conversational guidelines, and built-in safety mechanisms that can intervene when necessary.

As the platform handles sensitive mental health information, security, privacy, and responsible AI development are central to its design and ongoing operation.

If you thrive in complexity, entrepreneurial problem-solving, and believe in scaling through tech and AI, this is your PLACE.

Who Develops You: CTO

You are a seasoned engineer with 7+ years building and running production web applications, and you take a problem from a vague description to a shipped, monitored solution. You go deep on Ruby on Rails, including API-only services, ActiveRecord, PostgreSQL, background jobs, and RSpec. You're also comfortable shipping polished UI with React and TypeScript, and you've worked with GraphQL (ideally Apollo) on both server and client.

You've built distributed, event-driven systems and know how to debug failures that span services, using retries, idempotency, and eventual consistency. You've also tamed third-party integrations (REST, SOAP, webhooks) and partner APIs that are slow, inconsistent, or poorly documented. You treat sensitive personal and financial data with care and have strong instincts for security and multi-tenant data isolation.

You use AI and agentic coding tools at an advanced level every day, can describe how you structure context for agents and verify what they produce, and you build tooling that makes other engineers more effective. You communicate clearly: you can write a strong design doc, explain a production incident to a customer success manager, and disagree productively with a product manager. You own production through on-call, incident response, observability, and blameless postmortems.

Bonus points if you have experience in mortgage tech or a similar regulated, integration-heavy domain (fintech, lending, insurance, payments, healthcare), familiarity with LOS platforms (Encompass, MortgageBot, Byte) or MISMO standards, Node.js/TypeScript services, Elasticsearch, Redis, Docker, AWS, CI/CD, saga or workflow orchestration patterns, or a history of mentoring engineers and leading cross-team projects.

What You'll Do:

  • Design, build, and maintain features across Rails API services, TypeScript/Node services, a GraphQL gateway, and React frontends
  • Own integrations with external platforms (LOS systems, mortgage insurance providers, document and e-sign vendors), including data mapping, sync and reconciliation, retries, and idempotency
  • Design and evolve asynchronous, multi-step workflows using message queues (RabbitMQ, SNS/SQS), Sidekiq background jobs, and saga-style orchestration
  • Keep our multi-tenant platform correct and secure, respecting partner boundaries in every query and event
  • Lead technical design for significant features by writing design docs and architecture decision records, weighing trade-offs, and building alignment before you build
  • Identify and pay down technical debt, improving service boundaries, module design, test coverage, and developer experience
  • Hold a high bar in code review and help set engineering standards across the team
  • Join the on-call rotation, lead incident response, and follow through on root-cause fixes that prevent recurrence
  • Use observability tools and CI/CD to keep the platform healthy, and improve them where they fall short
  • Work directly with Customer Support & Success on lender-reported escalations, reproducing issues, investigating sync problems with external LOSs, and explaining findings clearly to non-engineers
  • Partner with Product Managers to refine requirements, uncover edge cases early, and propose simpler alternatives
  • Work with UI/UX Designers to turn designs into polished, accessible interfaces, and push back constructively when technical constraints affect the experience
  • Mentor other engineers through pairing, code review, and design feedback, including on effective AI-assisted workflows
  • Lead on AI-assisted engineering by using agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) daily to plan, implement, test, debug, and review, and by delegating well-scoped work to agents and reviewing their output rigorously
  • Build and maintain shared AI tooling for the team, including agent instruction files (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md), reusable skills and prompts, MCP servers connecting agents to internal systems, and automated workflows
